checks.name: Six strings are genuinely meshed with correct low-E to high-E numbering

C pressure and following fret support points are explicitly sampled by each string
Open string bottom action at nut and twelfth follows the shared canonical dimensions
All six open strings clear all twelve actual elliptical crown profiles
Nut groove seats and each string bottom agree at1.4mm above the board
Legitimate per-finger C offsets update actual string control points without changing fret or string
Six3+3 tuners and the requested175mm/14degree headstock are present
Surface normal winding faces outward on board, D back and metal crown
Geometry remains below20k triangles with finite normal/position/index data

limitations: Generic modeled design, not manufacturer CAD.
No actual browser/render visual review in this isolated geometry audit.
Wood grain is procedural; realism still depends on lighting, environment, materials and the validated hand pose.
70 static meshes are not a physical iPad frame-rate benchmark. Parent may merge/instance static hardware if profiling warrants it.
